body:
## Why

A card with unfinished children is a track by default. So `hkb promote <root>` does not queue that card —
it queues **one session that will run the root and every node under it**. Nothing at the moment of typing
says so.

Hit twice on this board. On 2026-09-03, `hkb promote 302` (track C's root, intended only to unpark the
lane) claimed a `claude-track` runner that fanned out to five nodes — `#303 → #304 → #288 → #305 → #302` —
which would have put root A *and* the entire TypeScript migration in a single opus session with no
per-node review gate. Recovery was `hkb track 302 --off`, `hkb block --kind transient`, `hkb unblock`,
`claude stop` on two agents, `claude rm` on two worktrees, and releasing a node's orphaned claim. The
earlier occurrence (2026-09-02, root C) cost ten minutes of runner time.

`hkb track <n>` already answers "is this a track and why" — but it is a command you have to know to run
*before* the one you were going to run. That is the gap: the information exists and arrives too late.

## What

1. `hkb promote <n>` on a card that would dispatch as a track says so **before** it writes, naming the
   nodes and the profile: `#302 is a track root — promoting it queues ONE claude-track session over 5
   nodes (#303 → #304 → #288 → #305 → #302). \`hkb track 302 --off\` runs them as cold nodes instead.`
   Under `--json`, the same as a `track` key on the result.
2. Consider making it a confirmation rather than a notice when the node count is above some small number,
   with `--yes` to skip — a five-node fan-out is a much bigger commitment than promoting a card, and the
   two are the same keystroke today. (Judgment call: a notice may be enough if it is loud. Decide on the
   card and say which.)
3. The same line in `hkb groom`'s proposal table, where promoting is what the table invites.

## Done when

- [ ] `hkb promote` on a track root prints the node list and the profile before it writes.
- [ ] `--json` carries it.
- [ ] Tests: a track root, a non-track card (no extra output), and `--off` suppressing it.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green.
title: hkb promote on a card with unfinished children silently starts a whole track, and there is no warning before it spawns
